All four runs — base1, inv1, dom1, agg1 — used identical harness code, system prompt, and task prompt. Each `harness.diff` in the candidate pool shows "(no change)". The same prompt template and single LLM call executed in all cases.

The variation in deliverables (base1 answered YES; inv1, dom1, agg1 answered NO) stems from stochastic model sampling on identical inputs, not from harness edits. The philosophical ambiguity of the question — whether sufficient causation is evaluated with prior conditions present or in isolation — drove the divergence in LLM responses, not harness configuration.
</edits>
